title: Complete a private secondary share sale
summary: When an existing holder proposes to sell privately held company shares to another investor. An authorized completed transfer or documented no-go, with reconciled consideration and ownership records.
outcomes: An authorized completed transfer or documented no-go, with reconciled consideration and ownership records.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When an existing holder proposes to sell privately held company shares to another investor.

parts.title: Identify the shares, parties and proposed terms
parts.guidance: Gather ownership evidence, instrument type, acquisition history, seller and buyer identities, price and proposed timetable. Distinguish a sale of existing shares from new company fundraising or an unexercised option.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Determine transfer restrictions and the legal route
parts.guidance: Counsel reviews governing documents, rights of first refusal, approvals, securities restrictions and the affected jurisdictions. Record required waivers, diligence and tax advice; do not treat private shares as freely tradable.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Determine transfer restrictions and the legal route

parts.title: Prepare the diligence and transfer pack
parts.guidance: Reconcile the seller's holding and assemble approved disclosures, transfer documents and a conditions checklist. Keep sensitive company information restricted and separate seller proceeds from money payable to the company.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve and execute closing
parts.guidance: Authorized parties satisfy the documented approvals and conditions, sign the approved documents and verify settlement instructions independently. Follow the agreed closing sequence and retain evidence before treating funds or shares as transferred.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Reconcile the register and reporting follow-up
parts.guidance: Match the completed transfer, payment evidence and updated ownership records. Issue approved confirmations, track unresolved conditions and route tax or securities reporting to the responsible professionals.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An authorized completed transfer or documented no-go, with reconciled consideration and ownership records.
